ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

color-size.note: Size and color update the live example below.

description.label: Form control for choosing a single numeric value from a continuous range with full keyboard, Angular Forms, and i18n support.

display.note: Inline shows label plus value in the header. Tooltip is opt-in above the thumb. Thumb renders the value under the thumb.

examples.note: Drag the thumb, click the track, or use the keyboard.

icons.note: Decorative edge icons frame the range; the thumb icon is free for any Solaris icon and never affects the accessible name.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the slider component.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

ticks.note: Tick marks are decorative (aria-hidden) and derive from showTicks plus tickStep or explicit tickValues.

scale.note: Static scale bounds mark the minimum and maximum of the track.
scale.scales-note: Log scales need explicit tickValues; zones recolor the fill by value.

vertical.note: Vertical fills bottom-to-top. Keyboard is identical on both axes: ArrowUp and ArrowRight increase.
